## 4. DESIGN SYSTEM (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

**Token file:** `design-tokens/tokens.json`
**CSS output:** `design-tokens/tokens.css` (auto-generated — do not edit)
**TypeScript:** `design-tokens/tokens.ts` (auto-generated — do not edit)

Regenerate tokens after editing tokens.json:
```bash
node scripts/generate-tokens.js
```

### How to use tokens in this project

In CSS / Tailwind:
```css
/* ✅ Correct */
color: var(--color-text-primary);
background: var(--color-brand-accent);
padding: var(--spacing-6);

/* ❌ Wrong */
color: #0A0A0A;
padding: 24px;
```

In Astro components:
```astro
<!-- ✅ Correct — Tailwind configured from tokens -->
<button class="bg-brand-accent text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg">

<!-- ❌ Wrong — hardcoded Tailwind colour -->
<button class="bg-indigo-500 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-lg">
```

### Component library location
`src/components/ui/` — always check here before building a new component.

Current components:
- `Button.astro` — primary, secondary, ghost variants
- `Badge.astro` — status labels
- `Card.astro` — content cards
- `Input.astro` — text inputs (for contact form)
- `Section.astro` — page section wrapper with consistent padding

## 5. NEVER DO LIST

### Environment & Identity
- ❌ Never hardcode Netlify site IDs in scripts or configs
- ❌ Never deploy to production manually — use the CI/CD pipeline
- ❌ Never commit secrets of any kind (there are none in this project — keep it that way)

### Code Quality
- ❌ Never use `any` type in TypeScript
- ❌ Never leave `console.log` in production code
- ❌ Never disable an ESLint rule without a comment explaining why
- ❌ Never add client-side JavaScript to this site without explicit justification
  (This is a static Astro site. JS is a liability, not a feature.)

### Design
- ❌ Never hardcode a colour, font size, spacing value, or border radius
- ❌ Never use Tailwind arbitrary values like `text-[#333]` or `p-[13px]`
- ❌ Never introduce a font not in the token system
- ❌ Never build a one-off component — add to the component library

### Performance (this is a marketing site — performance IS the product)
- ❌ Never use a `<img>` tag — always use Astro's `<Image>` component
- ❌ Never load a font from a CDN — self-host all fonts in `public/fonts/`
- ❌ Never add a third-party script without measuring its Lighthouse impact
- ❌ Never use `client:load` hydration — use `client:visible` or `client:idle`

---

## 6. ALWAYS DO LIST

### Before writing any code
- ✅ Check `src/components/ui/` — does a component exist?
- ✅ Check `design-tokens/tokens.json` — does a token exist for the value?
- ✅ Run `git status` — understand current branch

### When writing code
- ✅ Mobile-first. Design the 375px view before the 1280px view.
- ✅ Every page section is wrapped in `<Section>` from the component library
- ✅ Every image uses `<Image>` from `astro:assets`
- ✅ Every page has unique title and description meta
- ✅ Every interactive component has keyboard accessibility and focus states

### When finishing a task
- ✅ Run: `pnpm build` — confirm zero build errors
- ✅ Run: `pnpm type-check` — zero type errors
- ✅ Run: `pnpm lint` — zero lint errors
- ✅ Check Lighthouse: `pnpm lighthouse` — score must be ≥ 90
- ✅ Test mobile at 375px in browser devtools
- ✅ Write handoff report to `docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md`

---

## 7. SEO REQUIREMENTS

Every page must have:
- Unique `<title>` — 50–60 characters, includes "Acme" somewhere
- Unique `<meta description>` — 150–160 characters
- Open Graph tags (title, description, image at 1200×630)
- Canonical URL
- Structured data (Organisation on homepage, Article on blog posts)

Site-wide requirements:
- `public/sitemap.xml` — auto-generated by `@astrojs/sitemap`
- `public/robots.txt` — committed, allows all bots
- `public/llms.txt` — maintained, explains what Acme does for AI systems
- Lighthouse SEO score ≥ 90

---

## 8. PERFORMANCE BUDGET

This is a static marketing site. These are the performance requirements,
not aspirations. CI fails if they are not met.

| Metric | Required | Measured by |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| Lighthouse Performance | ≥ 95 | Lighthouse CI |
| Lighthouse Accessibility | ≥ 95 | Lighthouse CI |
| Lighthouse SEO | ≥ 95 | Lighthouse CI |
| First Contentful Paint | < 1.0s | Web Vitals |
| Largest Contentful Paint | < 1.5s | Web Vitals |
| Cumulative Layout Shift | < 0.05 | Web Vitals |
| Total page weight (homepage) | < 100kb gzipped | Build output |
| Images | WebP/AVIF only | Astro Image |

Static sites have no excuse for poor Lighthouse scores.

---

## 9. CONTENT STRUCTURE

Blog posts live in `src/content/blog/` as `.mdx` files.
The content schema is defined in `src/content/config.ts`.

Required frontmatter:
```yaml
---
title: "Post Title"          # 50–60 chars
description: "Description"  # 150–160 chars
publishedAt: 2025-03-19
author: "Author Name"
image: ./hero-image.jpg      # 1200×630 minimum
imageAlt: "Alt text"
tags: ["tag1", "tag2"]
draft: false
---
```

Never publish a post with `draft: true` in production.

---

## 10. COMMIT FORMAT

```
type(scope): description

Types: feat | fix | style | perf | content | seo | a11y | chore | docs
Scope: page name, component name, or section

Examples:
  feat(hero): add animated gradient headline
  fix(nav): correct mobile menu z-index overlap
  content(blog): publish Q1 product update post
  seo(homepage): add organisation structured data
  perf(images): convert PNG hero to WebP
  a11y(nav): add skip-to-content link
```
